text: Derive the relation I = nAev_d between current and drift speed.

points.text: In time t, electrons travel a distance v_d t.

The charge passing is nA v_d t e, so I = nAev_d.

facts: p12-2a:Starting from the motion of free electrons, obtain the microscopic form of Ohm’s
text: Starting from the motion of free electrons, obtain the microscopic form of Ohm’s law, J = σE.

points.text: An electron accelerates at a = eE/m between collisions.
So the drift speed is v_d = eEτ/m, where τ is the relaxation time.
Substituting into I = nAev_d gives J = (ne²τ/m)E.
The bracket is the conductivity, σ.
So J = σE, which is Ohm’s law at a point.
